changelog:
- Initial release of the airbnb-scraper-api skill.
- Search Airbnb stays with full discount ledger, including detailed price, rating, and stay details.
- Retrieve comprehensive information about a single listing, including complete amenity list and rating breakdown.
- Page through real guest reviews, including review text, ratings, and reviewer info.
- All endpoints return structured JSON; each call costs 1 credit.
- Requires a SCAVIO_API_KEY for access.
display_name: Airbnb Scraper API - Stay Search, Listing Detail, Reviews
summary: Search Airbnb stays with the full discount ledger, pull one listing with its complete amenity list and rating breakdown, and page through real review bodies. 3 endpoints, 1 credit each, structured JSON.
